name: Word processing & text documents
outputs: DOCX, ODT, PDF, HTML, EPUB, TXT, MD, RTF
notes: Word processing conversion is not equivalent to perfect layout preservation; Pages and legacy formats may need proprietary tools.

name: Page-layout, print & scanned documents
engines: Poppler, MuPDF, Ghostscript, Tesseract OCR, LibreOffice
outputs: PDF, PNG, JPG, TIFF, SVG, TXT, searchable PDF
notes: Scans need OCR. INDD/QXP/Publisher-style desktop publishing files require specialized importers and may be input-only.

name: Spreadsheets
outputs: XLSX, ODS, CSV, TSV, PDF, HTML, JSON, Parquet
notes: CSV/TSV lose formulas and formatting; macros cannot be preserved across every format.

name: Presentations & slides
outputs: PPTX, ODP, PDF, HTML, slide PNG/JPG, video (rendered)
notes: KEY/KEYNOTE and PEZ may need native apps or limited extractors; video requires timed rendering.

name: Ebooks, comics & help books
outputs: EPUB, AZW3, PDF, HTML, TXT, DOCX, CBZ
notes: DRM-protected ebooks cannot be assumed convertible. ACSM is an authorization/download token, not book content.

name: Raster images & layered editors
engines: ImageMagick, libvips, Pillow, OpenImageIO, specialized editors
outputs: PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP, GIF, PDF, ICO
notes: Layered documents may flatten; HDR/color space, transparency, animation and metadata may be lost.

name: Digital-camera RAW photos
outputs: TIFF, PNG, JPG, DNG (where supported)
notes: RAW development uses demosaicing and camera color profiles; lossless reconstruction into another camera RAW format is generally impossible.

name: Vector graphics, diagrams & design
engines: Inkscape, CairoSVG, librsvg, LibreOffice Draw, format-specific SDKs
outputs: SVG, PDF, PNG, EPS, DXF (compatible geometry)
notes: Native vector/design files often contain application-specific semantics. PNG→SVG needs tracing, not ordinary format conversion.

name: Audio recordings & codecs
outputs: MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OPUS, OGG, AIFF, M4A
notes: Codec and container differ; AA/AAX may be encrypted or restricted. Lossy→lossless does not restore audio quality.

name: MIDI, tracker music & DAW projects
outputs: MIDI, rendered WAV/MP3, stems (where available)
notes: MIDI and trackers need soundfonts/instruments for audio; proprietary DAW project interchange is rarely lossless.

name: Video files, cinema media & raw streams
outputs: MP4, MKV, WEBM, MOV, AVI, GIF, frame PNG/JPG, audio
notes: Camera cinema RAW and proprietary surveillance formats may require vendor decoders; codecs must be available.

name: Subtitles, lyrics & captions
outputs: SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, TTML, TXT
notes: Image-based subtitles need OCR to recover words; caption styling/timing may not transfer perfectly.

name: Archives, packages & compression
outputs: ZIP, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.XZ, TAR.ZST
notes: Many formats can be read but not written; repacking loses signatures and some package metadata.

name: Disk images, optical media & virtual machines
outputs: ISO, IMG, QCOW2, VHDX, VMDK, extracted folders
notes: Disk filesystem extraction differs from VM-image conversion; bootability and filesystem metadata must be preserved.

name: 3D models, scans & animation
outputs: GLB, GLTF, OBJ, STL, PLY, FBX, USD, 3MF
notes: Geometry may convert while materials, skeletons, shaders, procedural modifiers or animations do not.

name: Engineering CAD, BIM, PCB & manufacturing
engines: FreeCAD, Open Cascade, LibreCAD, KiCad, vendor SDKs
outputs: STEP, IGES, DXF, STL, 3MF, SVG, Gerber, G-code
notes: CAD solid-to-mesh loses editable parametric features. RVT, SolidWorks and other vendor native files require special importers.

name: Maps, GIS, GPS & elevation/point clouds
outputs: GeoJSON, GPKG, KML, GPX, SHP, GeoTIFF, LAS, LAZ
notes: Raster, vector, topology, projection and point-cloud transforms are distinct operations; use CRS-aware tools.

name: Structured data, tables & serialization
engines: Python stdlib, jq, yq, pyarrow, DuckDB, pandas
outputs: JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, YAML, XML, Parquet, Arrow
notes: Arbitrary schemas are not interchangeable without mappings; never deserialize unknown pickle/joblib files unsandboxed.

name: Databases & database exports
engines: SQLite, DuckDB, database drivers, MDB Tools, sql-dump parsers
outputs: SQL, CSV, JSON, Parquet, SQLite, DuckDB
notes: DB conversion requires schema, constraints, sequences, collations and type mapping; WAL/SHM and other component files are not stand-alone databases.

name: Web documents, code & markup
engines: Pandoc, language parsers, Prettier, transpilers, notebook tools
outputs: HTML, PDF, Markdown, TXT, formatted code, notebook HTML/PDF
notes: Code syntax translation is not ordinary file conversion. TS→JS is transpilation; Python→JavaScript needs dedicated tools and may not be equivalent.

name: Fonts & typography
outputs: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2, TTX, SVG glyph previews
notes: Font licensing, outlines, kerning, variations and hinting constrain valid output.

name: Email, contacts, calendars & web archives
engines: email parsers, libpst/readpst, libical, vCard libraries
outputs: EML, MBOX, PDF, HTML, CSV contacts, VCF, ICS
notes: Proprietary mailbox archives may require dedicated extractors; attachments, headers and recurrence rules matter.

name: Medical, scientific, chemical & research
engines: pydicom, nibabel, BioPython, Open Babel, HDF5/netCDF libraries
outputs: NIfTI, NRRD, DICOM, CSV, JSON, PDB, SDF, MOL2, FASTA
notes: Scientific meaning and metadata are essential; clinical formats require extra privacy/security controls.

name: Game, modding & graphics assets
engines: AssetRipper-like parsers, UModel, format-specific tools, Blender
outputs: Extracted assets, WAV/PNG/OBJ where decoded, ZIP-compatible containers
notes: Game assets and ROMs are often custom versioned/encoded; generic game-file-to-game-file conversion is not realistic.

name: Executable, firmware & low-level binary containers
engines: binwalk, objcopy, LLVM utilities, platform SDKs
outputs: Extracted resources, Intel HEX, S-record, UF2 where compatible
notes: Executable-to-source is decompilation (inexact), not conversion. Firmware repacking/signing may require vendor keys.
